title: Simulating Psychological Risks in Human-AI Interactions: Real-Case Informed Modeling of AI-Induced Addiction, Anorexia, Depression, Homicide, Psychosis, and Suicide

bias_targets.methodology: Logistic regression analysis evaluating whether model safety outcomes (improving versus worsening a psychological crisis) differ across simulated multi-turn scenarios featuring child, teenager, adult, and elderly personas.
Logistic regression analysis evaluating whether model safety outcomes differ across simulated multi-turn scenarios featuring male versus female personas.
Logistic regression analysis evaluating whether model safety outcomes differ across simulated multi-turn scenarios featuring personas with low, middle, and high income levels.
